scope: Local-only validated runtime images; not remote pull references or an offline image delivery

websiteBuild.mode: Targeted host Web build using existing locked dependencies; static runtime image via compose.prebuilt.yaml; unchanged H5 artifact reused from round2
websiteBuild.treeDigestAlgorithm: Sorted relative path + NUL + file SHA256 hex + newline for web/src, web/public, package.json, yarn.lock, vue.config.js

sourceBuildCaveat: Base image tags and OS package repositories are not a bit-for-bit reproducible lock. Record newly built image IDs/platform on new hosts. This targeted build is not a new clean dependency install.
